Any JavaScript function can be called from the eventing infrastructure on the metadata screens. This page describes the functions that are provided by base SCALE as default or "common" functions. They should be used whenever possible to avoid rewriting code and reinventing logic.
Opens a new page in the current browser tab.
Opens a new page in a modal dialog.
Invokes a POST web service call.
Invokes a PUT web service call.
Saves data on a Details screen, which could be either an insert or an update.
POSTServiceURL or PUTServiceURL + specific web service parameters
Opens a new page in the current browser tab.
Opens a new page in the current browser tab where the html is obtained by a POST call.
Opens a new page in a modal dialog.
Invokes a GET web service call.
Invokes a POST web service call with optional prompt beforehand.
Invokes a POST web service call with optional prompt beforehand for multiple rows.
Invokes a GET web service call that returns a confirmation message displayed to the user in a modal. If the user confirms positively, a POST web service call is made.
Invokes a POST web service call from a modal dialog and then hides the modal dialog.

Invokes a POST web service call that returns a confirmation message displayed to the user in a modal. If the user confirms positively, another call POST web service call is made to the same web service (without confirmation).
